family.description: PerM is an integral membrane protein containing 8-10 transmembrane helices that is highly conserved amongst mycobacteria and actinobacteria but absent from other bacterial lineages. The protein functions as an essential component of the mycobacterial divisome complex, directly interacting with FtsB through conserved hydrophobic residues. PerM localises to division septa where it modulates cell wall synthesis, with activity critically dependent on magnesium availability. Disruption results in magnesium-dependent growth defects, cell elongation, hypersensitivity to beta-lactam antibiotics, and severe attenuation during chronic infections. The protein appears to integrate environmental stress signals, enabling mycobacteria to regulate cell division in response to host-induced stress during persistent infection.
family.name: Cell division protein PerM
